data.name: Jillene
data.gender_notes: Jillene is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old French name Gilliane, meaning 'pledge' or 'promise'. In Latin, 'Jillis' means 'youthful' or 'young one'. The name Jillene has a gentle flow, reminiscent of the calm, peaceful waters of a stream. The name Jillene carries the meaning “Gentle flow” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jillene usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle flow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's promise and divine protection.
data.etymology: Jillene belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle flow.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jillene total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
